description: The line plot illustrates the performance of three methods—On-policy RL, LUFFY, and SFT—measured as Accuracy (Pass@1) on the y-axis, as a function of Temperature on the x-axis, which ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis, labeled “Accuracy (Pass@1)”, spans from 62.5 to 82.5, also on a linear scale, with gridlines at intervals of 2.5. The red line with star markers, representing LUFFY, starts at approximately 76.5 at Temperature 0.0, dips slightly to around 75.5 at 0.1, then rises steadily to peak near 81.5 at 0.9 before a slight drop at 1.0. The teal line with triangle markers, representing SFT, begins at 76.5, remains relatively flat until 0.3, then drops to 72.5 at 0.4, rises to 78.5 at 0.5, dips again to 75.0 at 0.6, and ends near 79.0 at 1.0. The orange line with diamond markers, representing On-policy RL, starts at 65.0, jumps to 71.0 at 0.1, fluctuates between 70.0 and 75.0 until 0.6, then drops sharply to 71.0 at 0.7, rises to 78.5 at 0.8, and ends at 77.5 at 1.0. All three lines show non-monotonic behavior, with LUFFY generally achieving the highest accuracy across most temperature values.
